QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_24

question.text: Under Section 5.7.2, when establishing the overall SIA engagement strategy, the Social Impact Assessor should do ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Identify the characteristics of the engagement that define its audit scope
Ascertain the reporting objectives, timing, and nature of communications required
Predetermine the impact conclusion (Clean/Qualified) before fieldwork, to set expectations with the SE
Ascertain the nature, timing, and extent of resources necessary

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.121 lists planning-strategy steps that include identifying engagement characteristics that define scope (Option A), ascertaining reporting objectives, timing, and communications (Option B), and ascertaining the nature, timing, and extent of resources required (Option D). Pre-determining the impact conclusion before fieldwork (Option C) is not on that list and conflicts with the independence, objectivity, and evidence-based principles described on pp.108-109. The Trap: All of A, B, and D are required planning-strategy items per p.121. Only C is inconsistent with the framework. Note: Independence, objectivity, and evidence-based conclusions on pp.108-109 directly preclude forming an opinion before fieldwork begins.
